reason: The before code has no method/status gate before the ETag generation and If-None-Match comparison (the PR states the method/status check existed only in the `*` branch), so a POST with a matching non-`*` If-None-Match could be answered 304 — exactly the behavior the commit "skip unsafe methods or error responses on non-* case" fixes; the reviewer's framing of it as a "removal" is historically confused but the substantive claim about the before code is true.
